decisions.reason: The net price display plugin is core shop-extension know-how the firm can maintain cheaply, but its absence from the website since 2020 and the earlier withdrawal of the related reporting plugin suggest fading attention.
ERP integration builds on deep in-house integration expertise and recurring client demand, so the firm can keep adapting it despite low website visibility.

The firm understands price comparison tracking well and can still learn from its results, but a sibling plugin was already withdrawn and this one has not appeared on the website since 2020, making consolidation fairly likely.
As an overlapping variant in a family the firm has already started pruning, it is the most likely candidate for consolidation, freeing development capacity for multichannel and mobile commerce work.
